Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher for its large third rack.
Comments (English): [ Bought it for the 3rd rack ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher for its large third rack. It will hold coffee cups, small cereal, bowls, and other items so that it frees up the regular top rack for your glasses and other midsize items. Love the 3rd rack. All other brands have pretty much flat 3rd racks. (Except for the other brand that is obviously made by the same company.) As best i can tell after having it a few weeks, the actual cleaning is great. However, I absolutely despise the fact that you cannot set a favorite cycle. Nor can you make it where the heat dry automatically is not turned on. So if somebody turns on the dishwasher and forgets to turn off the heat dry every single time you run the dishwasher, then the heat dry automatically comes on. It melted plastic items even on the top rack. That is ridiculous. In today's energy conscious world the default should be no heat and then if you want to turn on the heat dry that should be the option. Not the other way around. I would love to be able to permanently disable the heating element on it, but I have yet to figure out how to do that. As in I would pay an electrician to come out and pull the dishwasher out of the hole and disconnect the wires from the heating element if I did not think it will disable the dishwasher. For the amount of money that this dishwasher costs, KitchenAid could do better.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher in June, but I did not receive it until a month later.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher great, service experience, not so great ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher in June, but I did not receive it until a month later. When it arrived, it was installed by the delivery guys who were nice. We were very busy that week, so I was not cooking/eating at home to generate any dishes so I could try it for a few more days. When I opened it to load it for the first time, I noticed that the middle rack was not sitting level. I figured it must be an adjustment that needed to be changed on one side since the middle rack is height adjustable. Upon closer inspection, I saw that the front plastic tab that holds up the rack was broken off on one side. I looked, but I did not see the missing piece anywhere in the machine. I called Kitchenaid to see if they could send me a replacement part, but they told me they would need to send a technician to come to fix it. The soonest day they could send someone was four days later, on a Friday. When the day came for the service technician to come, I had to stay home from work since they could not give me a specific time. Nobody called, nobody texted or emailed and nobody showed up. I was NOT happy. I called Kitchenaid again on Monday, because they were already closed for the day when I tried on Friday. The person I spoke to was very nice, but after she did some research, she said she found a message in the file from the service company saying they no longer served our area. Nobody bothered to let me know that. It certainly would have been helpful, so I did not have to miss work, sit around and wait all day. She found a different service company, but the soonest they could come was another ten days. She gave me the direct number for the company so I called them to request that they let me know if they had a cancellation so I could possible get the part replaced sooner. They agreed. A couple of days later they called and said they could come that day. I was happy. I stayed home again and this time the technician showed up as scheduled. He looked at the dishwasher and immediately said I had diagnosed the problem correctly. (No kidding! It was such an easy thing to see). When I asked him how long it would take to fix it, he said he did not have the part and would have to order it, which would take another eight days. He would have to come back again. Seriously? I had told them exactly what the issue was, so they should have come prepared to fix the problem. On the seventh day, I received a text saying the part still had not come in and they did not have a new update as to when to expect it. Meanwhile I have had to resort to using a heavy rubber band from the upper rack to hold the middle rack up so I can use the brand new dishwasher I paid over $1000 for almost two months ago. I do love the dishwasher so far, other than this service issue. It has a great design and I LOVE the third top rack. This dishwasher is SO quiet, even if I stand next to it I have to look to see if the lights are on to know the cycle is in progress. I would definitely recommend it to my friends and family. My suggestion to Kitchenaid/Whirlpool is that they work on their inventory stocking and parts availability. It is ridiculous that it should a month to get a new appliance and then take weeks to get simple parts on brand new machine. COVID is not a valid excuse any longer. Poor planning and inventory management is the issue here. We are SO over that COVID reason given for everything that is not done as expected after over two years. Also, the sections of the basket that are meant for larger items are too small to fit some items that I used to put in our old basket, such as plastic lids that might fly around and the blade attachment of our blender.- The cycle lengths are very long.  There is the Express Wash cycle, which is shorter, but it actually uses more water than any other cycle, so I never use it.  Something like a Light Wash resource-efficient cycle for small, lightly-soiled loads would be a great idea.  The Pro Wash cycle always takes at least 2.5 hrs, no matter what.- I don't know if there's something wrong with our machine, but it makes an annoying, high-pitched hum during certain parts of the cycle that I can hear from the 2nd floor of the house.  It's hard to be in the same room with it sometimes.  It's not a loud noise, but it's very penetrating.  The decibel level is still in the mid 40s though.- The shallow part of the upper rack doesn't receive enough water to clean heavily-soiled, deep items, such as measuring cups.  There needs to be a better water spray that hits dishes from the bottom, rather than just the one spray arm at the top of the machine.  The rotating bars that clean the glasses don't seem to spray far enough to clean the underside of the whole top rack.- The handle on the removable tray on the top rack is unnecessary and just takes up otherwise usable space. - The chime that indicates the cycle end needs to be a little bit louderOverall, I'd still recommend this dishwasher.  We've only had it for a little over a month, so I can't comment on how long it will last.  I've also never used the dry cycle, so I don't know how well it works.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher because the old one started failing to start a few months ago.
Comments (English): [ Good value for money. Pretty quiet ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher because the old one started failing to start a few months ago. It is good value for money and the "Home Connect" app is very useful for programming the dishwasher for mid-morning or mid-day, which are usually the times when electricity costs the least. It has a small hole in the top tray so that when you close and start the dishwasher, the tablet stays and does not fall on the floor of the dishwasher (my old dishwasher did not have this). We usually put the 1-hour program on a day-to-day basis, because the ECO program lasts a long time: just over 3 hours. This, for me, is a negative point, although I understand that it will have its explanation to save water (I imagine that it will reuse the water released by the dishwasher in cycles to save water). The drying function is quite effective and, at least, the cutlery, plates and glasses are left to store directly (tupperware, pans, casseroles and other things may need to be left on the draining board to finish drying). . This function is included in the ECO and 1-hour programs, which are the ones I have used (I don't know about the others, although I imagine it will). Regarding the installation and uninstallation service and collection of the old dishwasher, 10/10. The guy who came to install it was very nice and installed the dishwasher in no time.
Comments (Original): [ Buena relación calidad-precio. Bastante silencioso ] || ---------------- || Compramos este lavaplatos porque el anterior empezó a fallar en el encendido desde hace unos meses. Tiene una buena relación calidad-precio y la app 'Home Connect' es muy útil para programar el lavaplatos en mitad de la madrugada o al mediodía, que suelen ser las horas donde cuesta menos la electricidad. Tiene un pequeño hueco en la bandeja superior para que, cuando cierras y pones en funcionamiento el lavaplatos, se quede la pastilla y no caiga al suelo del lavaplatos (esto no lo tenía mi lavaplatos antiguo).Nosotros solemos poner el programa de 1 horas en el día a día, porque el programa ECO dura muchísimo: algo más de 3 horas. Esto, para mi, es un punto negativo, aunque entiendo que tendrá su explicación para ahorrar agua (imagino que reutilizará el agua que suelta el lavaplatos por ciclos para ahorar agua).La función de secado es bastante efectiva y, al menos, los cubiertos, los platos y los vasos los deja para guardarlos directamente (los tuppers, las sartenes, las cazerolas y otras cosas pueden requerir dejarlos en el escurreplatos para que se terminen de secar). Esta función la tienen incorporada los programas ECO y de 1 hora, que son los que yo he usado (los demás, lo desconozco, aunque imagino que la tendrá).Respecto al servicio de instalación y desinstalación y recogida del lavaplatos antiguo, 10/10. El chico que vino a instalarlo fue muy agradable e instaló el lavaplatos en muy poco tiempo.

Comments (English): [ Bosch dishwasher review ] || ---------------- || After having a season without a functioning dishwasher this is refreshing! This might be typical for most dishwashers (my significantly less expensive dishwasher did not have this “problem”), but the door seems to close aggressively, meaning you need to guide it close or else it will slam. Not a big deal at all, but this would be a nice feature to have. We have gotten used to this and is no longer a big deal. 2. The kick plate that covers the bottom part of the dishwasher came in black stainless, even though the dishwasher is silver. Very well could have been a simple mistake on Bosch's end. Again, not a big deal. We barely notice it. 3. The light that shines on the ground is excellent. We recess our washer underneath the countertop fully, so the control panel is not visible. Indicating that the dishwasher is on via the red light is nice, given how quiet the dishwasher is. My recommendation would be having a RED light be an issue with the dishwasher (cycle paused, errror, etc) and a GREEN light be the washer is running with no issues.I'll state it again…excellent dishwasher and would highly recommend to anyone considering buying a new one. You won't regret it.

Sentence (English): I really like this Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, Dry & Clean ] || ---------------- || I really like this Bosch dishwasher. It's a beautiful looking dishwasher with adjustable racks and plenty of room. The top (3rd) rack is very handy, especially with the adjustment for larger items like ladles or ramekins. It is unbelievably quiet, you can't even tell its running other than the light on the door and the occasional draining you can hear coming from the sink drain. The insulation around the machine is a solid layer of some type of material not the fluffy type I've normally seen used, it appears to do a great job at deadening the sound and heat. My last dishwasher used to radiate plenty of heat during the drying cycle, this one not much at all. It does dry everything very well, even the plastic containers. Unless there is pooled up water on something it is essentially completely dry at the end of the cycle. It cleans everything well, even pans and casserole dishes with cooked on foods. I don't rinse unless there is a lot of residue and even then, I literally just rinse and still everything is coming clean. I've had a least 3 different brands of dishwashers and they all did a pretty good job at cleaning but the quietness and the drying of this Bosch stand out as by far the best I've had. I also have to add the junction box set up for the installation is awesome, it plugs into the machine and the box is at the other end of a cord. This made wiring the unit so much easier and cleaner, other machines have the junction box deep under the machine and are a pain to wire. It also has a regular 3-prong plug if you have an outlet, again the one end just simply plugs into the machine rather than needing to be hard wired

Sentence (English): Just installed the Bosch 300 series 24 in.
Comments (English): [ Looks good, works good ] || ---------------- || Just installed the Bosch 300 series 24 in. stainless steel front control tall tub dishwasher with stainless steel tub and 3rd rack last week and so far so good. The dishwasher looks and feels well made with the stainless steel interior and door and the front panel touch controls work well with just a light touch. The installation was fairly standard for a dishwasher, the only differences would be the plug in power cord that connects at the back and the waterline connection being at the back too. We have run three loads of dishes so far and the dishwasher is fairly quiet which is nice with the kitchen being open to the living room and they come out clean and dry like they should. The unique way the dishwasher dries dishes with the heat from the hot water is a new one to us and seeing water condensation on the inside of the tub and racks is a little strange but it works, just unload the dishes from the bottom first to keep them from getting wet from the upper racks. The wifi controls work fine but to be honest is really necessary, this is a dishwasher not a tv or dvd player. Also the provided instruction for using the dishwasher are lacking as they want you to go online for it, not very happy about that. Overall it is a good dishwasher that looks nice, cleans and dries the dishes and is quiet while it is on.

Comments (English): [ Only a few minor issues ] || ---------------- || Starting with the bad:- The rubber seal between the door and the body of the dishwasher was warped on arrival. Maytag refused to even look at a photo of it, saying that I would have to call out a service tech (costing 1/4 the price of a new dishwasher! ) to look at it, and if the tech deemed it to be a manufacturing defect, they would then waive the cost of the service call.- As others have mentioned, the insulation blanket that goes over the top doesn't have any way to fasten to the body, so it took a lot of finagling to get it to not slide off as we pushed the dishwasher under the counter.- The steam vent doesn't close while the dishwasher is off, so if you're loading/unloading the dishwasher and splash any water in that area, it will leak through the door and onto the floor.- The door requires a decent amount of force to open all the way so that the bottom rack can roll out evenly. The first few times I used it, I thought where I had it was all the way open and the rack kept wanting to roll back inside.On to the good! - The inside is exactly the same size as my old dishwasher, yet somehow I can fit much taller items on both the top AND bottom rack! Not sure what kind of black magic Maytag came up with for that, but I like it! - My old dishwasher was rated at 55 dB, and this one is 50 dB. You wouldn't think 5 dB would be that big of a difference, but from the next room over I can hardly hear it running at all.- It has a countdown timer for how long the cleaning cycle will take. This might be a typical feature, but my old dishwasher only had an on/off light, so I think this is neat.- Other than that, it does all the things a dishwasher should do. Put dirty dishes and detergent in, push a button, get clean dishes out.

If you wash at a high temperature, it is definitely washed well in case of oil stains, and you always add a rinse. Originally, when washing dishes by hand, I tend to lather and rinse after washing the first dishes, but using the dishwasher after washing the first dishes reduces the number of hands and is very convenient. (Even if you say washing dishes, it is about removing food by rinsing with water.) . Since I primed and turned the dishwasher, the bottom residue hardly accumulates, but it's good to wash it at least once a week. The noise part is actually much quieter than I thought, so I hardly bothered. Sometimes when I turn the dishwasher during the day, I don't dry it with hot air and just let it dry naturally, but from the 4th picture onwards, the drying function is not used. It doesn't drip or drip like I thought. Anyway, I've been using it for less than a month, and it's so convenient and good. I regretted installing it sooner as the time I spent worrying about was wasted. I love both the design and functional aspects! I hope my review will help those who are thinking about it. #Samsung Electronics event participation
Comments (Original): [ 식세기 구입은 진짜 오래 전부터 하려고 알아보고 고민했는데 이제야... ] || ---------------- || 식세기 구입은 진짜 오래 전부터 하려고 알아보고 고민했는데 이제야 설치했습니다.4식구인데 14인용이 너무 크진 않을까 싶었지만 부피가 큰 냄비 종류를 많이 사용하기도 하고 아이들 때문에 컵이며 잔잔한 설거지 거리가 워낙 자주 많이 나오는 편이라 큰 용량으로 선택했어요.직접 사용해보니 14인용으로 선택하길 잘 한 것 같습니다.깔끔하게 빌트인 하는 방식을 선호했는데 저희 집 주방 구조상 자리가 나오질 않아서 기존에 빌트인 되어있던 전자렌지&오븐을 철거 후 아일랜드 식탁 쪽 서랍을 빼고 그쪽으로 옮겼어요.렌지오븐을 다른 쪽으로 옮기고 재설치하는 바람에 일이 이중으로 작업 되었지만 따로 비용이 추가되지는 않았어요.이렇게 철거가 끝나면 바로 설치가 들어가진 못하고 빌트인 된 후에 앞쪽 상판을 제작해야하기 때문에 일주일 정도 후에 설치가 진행됩니다.2번째가 설치가 된 사진이고 3번째는 상판을 달은 사진입니다.인테리어가 블랙&그레이의 모던풍인데 무광 블랙으로 상판을 선택하니 깔끔하고 포인트가 되어서 만족스러웠어요.상판 추가 금액은 5만이 있는데 개인적으로는 추가하는걸 추천드려요.총 3단으로 된 식세기 내부에 무게가 있는 큰 냄비나 그릇류는 1층에 넣고 2층은 보통 가벼운 그릇이나 컵 종류, 3층은 수저 종류를 넣어 사용합니다.테트리스를 잘하면 정말 많이 들어가는데 하루에 한번 정도 모아두고 사용하는데도 빡빡하게 넣을 필요는 없더라구요.고온세척을 하면 확실히 기름때 같은 경우 잘 씻기고 헹굼추가는 항상 하는 편입니다.열풍건조도 보통 사용하는데 건조 기능을 사용해도 완벽하게 마르진 않기 때문에 세척이 끝나면 항상 문을 열어서 자는 동안 자연건조를 해주고 아침에 식기를 정리하는 루틴으로 사용 중입니다.원래도 손 설거지를 할 때 애벌 설거지 후 거품과 헹굼을 하는 편인데 애벌 설거지를 해서 식세기를 사용하니 일손이 훨씬 줄어들고 너무 편합니다. (애벌 설거지라고 해봤자 물로 헹궈서 음식물을 제거해주는 정도입니다.)애벌을 해서 식세기를 돌리다보니 아래 찌꺼지도 거의 쌓이지 않긴 하지만 1주일에 한번 정도는 씻어주시는게 좋아요.소음부분은 진짜 생각보다 훨씬 조용해서 거의 신경쓰이진 않아요.가끔 낮에 식세기를 돌릴 때는 열풍건조를 하지 않고 그냥 자연건조 시키기도 하는데 4번째 사진부터가 건조 기능을 사용하지 않을 때입니다.생각처럼 물이 뚝뚝 흐르거나 그러진 않아요.어쨌든 한달 좀 안되게 사용 중인데 너무 편리하고 좋습니다.고민했던 시간이 아까울만큼 좀 더 빨리 설치할거 하고 후회되더라구요.디자인적인 면도 기능적인 면도 다 너무 마음에 들어요!제 사용후기가 고민 중이신 분들에게 도움이 되길 바랍니다.#삼성전자이벤트참여

(애벌 설거지라고 해봤자 물로 헹궈서 음식물을 제거해주는 정도입니다.)애벌을 해서 식세기를 돌리다보니 아래 찌꺼지도 거의 쌓이지 않긴 하지만 1주일에 한번 정도는 씻어주시는게 좋아요.소음부분은 진짜 생각보다 훨씬 조용해서 거의 신경쓰이진 않아요.가끔 낮에 식세기를 돌릴 때는 열풍건조를 하지 않고 그냥 자연건조 시키기도 하는데 4번째 사진부터가 건조 기능을 사용하지 않을 때입니다.생각처럼 물이 뚝뚝 흐르거나 그러진 않아요.어쨌든 한달 좀 안되게 사용 중인데 너무 편리하고 좋습니다.고민했던 시간이 아까울만큼 좀 더 빨리 설치할거 하고 후회되더라구요.디자인적인 면도 기능적인 면도 다 너무 마음에 들어요!제 사용후기가 고민 중이신 분들에게 도움이 되길 바랍니다.#삼성전자이벤트참여

When I tried it myself, I think I did a good job choosing it for 14 people. I preferred the clean built-in method, but due to the structure of our kitchen, there was no space, so I removed the built-in microwave & oven, removed the island table side drawer, and moved it there. Moving the oven to the other side and reinstalling it doubled the work, but it didn't add extra cost. After the demolition is finished, the installation will not go in right away, and the installation will be carried out after about a week because the front top plate must be produced after it is built in. The 2nd picture is the installed picture and the 3rd picture is the top plate attached. The interior is a modern style of black & gray, but I was satisfied with the top plate in matte black because it was neat and a point. The additional amount of the top plate is 50,000, but I personally recommend adding it. Inside the three-tiered dishwasher, heavy pots and bowls are placed on the first floor, and light bowls and cups are usually placed on the second floor, and cutlery and cutlery are placed on the third floor. If you're good at Tetris, you can put in a lot, but I don't need to put it tightly even though I use it once a day. If you wash at a high temperature, it is definitely washed well in case of oil stains, and you always add a rinse. I usually use hot air drying, but even if I use the drying function, it doesn't dry completely, so I always open the door after washing to let it dry naturally while I sleep, and I use it as a routine to organize the tableware in the morning. Originally, when washing dishes by hand, I tend to lather and rinse after washing the first dishes, but using the dishwasher after washing the first dishes reduces the number of hands and is very convenient. (Even if you say washing dishes, it is about removing food by rinsing with water.) . Since I primed and turned the dishwasher, the bottom residue hardly accumulates, but it's good to wash it at least once a week. The noise part is actually much quieter than I thought, so I hardly bothered. Sometimes when I turn the dishwasher during the day, I don't dry it with hot air and just let it dry naturally, but from the 4th picture onwards, the drying function is not used. It doesn't drip or drip like I thought. Anyway, I've been using it for less than a month, and it's so convenient and good. I regretted installing it sooner as the time I spent worrying about was wasted. I love both the design and functional aspects! I hope my review will help those who are thinking about it. #Samsung Electronics event participation

Sentence (English): I unfortunately regret buying this dishwasher and would not recommend it unless you are absolutely sure your dishes will fit well in the rack.
Comments (English): [ Inefficient rack layout ] || ---------------- || I unfortunately regret buying this dishwasher and would not recommend it unless you are absolutely sure your dishes will fit well in the rack. We use a lot of deep bowls and Pyrex food containers that do not fit anywhere in this dishwasher. Because there are only two rows of tines on the bottom row, there is a lot of unused space in the center. If there were one additional row of tines, deeper bowls and dishes could be place in between the rows of tines (perpendicular to the way that plates sit with tines in between each one). Because the second rack has a stepped design, bowls or deeper food storage containers will not sit properly that rack either. I thought I would get the hang of it in the month that we have had this dishwasher, but the dishwasher Tetris has become so frustrating, I could never recommend this dishwasher to someone else. If I hadn't just spent so much money on it (along with the three other matching appliances), I would replace it.

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher good; installation experience horrible ] || ---------------- || We rarely used our dishwasher since one of the hinges were broken. Finally decided to upgrade and went with Costco. Since we have not previous experience, we can't really compare but it does the job fine. In terms of sound, it's not too loud, but again we have nothing to compare against. Our main gripe is with the installation. We know Costco outsources to 3rd parties. Our installer came on time, on the early side of the time frame. Actually waited a few more minutes for actual delivery but not a big deal. First thing installer does is to try and upsell us on getting new air gap, new hose, and valve handles. We go downstairs to shut off the water valve, and he uses a lot of force and breaks the handle. It seemed quite intentional. Well, we can't install the dishwasher that day. I called handyman who said a plumber should fix. Both the handyman and plumber noted that the installer shouldn't have used such force to break the handle to water valve.After getting the handle fixed, I subsequently rescheduled the installation requesting a different installer. This guy came and he even said the first installer shouldn't have broken the handle. We did have to buy an "extender" for the water hose line, and had to pay the installer directly (not the 3rd party company), which I thought was weird. He said he'd send me a receipt which I never got.I told Costco about the broken water valve handle when rescheduling the installation but I have not heard back. Needless to say, I'm pretty disappointed with this installation experience and Costco not following up on the matter.

I found the tools needed for installation were very minimal. There are 3 basic installation connections to make: the water inlet line connection with an elbow connection, the plug-in power cord, and the drain hose attachment. These 3 connections will then be run thru the hole in your cabinet wall (on the side of the inner dishwasher cabinet space) to be connected under the kitchen sink. Mind you, these are general summed up installation steps but every install is different & you will have to go over the installation manual to correctly install the dishwasher. It's always ok though to get a professional plumber to correctly & smoothly install the dishwasher. So decide what's best for you & your kitchen space. HEAVY (baked on or greasy items) for intensified deep cleaning. AUTO is my "Go-To" cycle option because it lets the dishwasher clean well based on sensing how dirty the items are in the washer & adjusts time & intensity (of cleaning) automatically. Remember that this dishwasher is a smart appliance so it will sense the best washing cycle for the items. That adds to the ease-of-use of this great dishwasher. NORMAL is a great everyday wash that saves energy & water. SPEED60 is perfect for a speedy wash on lightly dirty dishes. Comments (English): [ Very Clean Dishes - Lots of options and it is Quiet ] || ---------------- || What a fancy dishwasher. Clean dishes and everything else. Quiet without a doubt. We ran a sanitizing cycle and it took a few hours. Really only need this on rare occasions but had to try it out. Honestly it took a bit of time to figure it out all the options. Lots of combo buttons and I still need the guide to program it. Lots of options to run different cycles. We'll mostly use normal. The PowerControl is cool allowing you to decide which of 4 wash zone quadrants of the bottom tray get one of 3 cleaning levels Light-Normal-Heavy. I imagine this is really useful for cleaning a heavily soiled pan. The dishes come out very clean and dry. One item placed on the top 3rd rack didn't clean very well but it really should have been on the bottom rack. I can't imagine anything missing on this dishwasher.Bottom rack was very difficult initially to push fully in until after running a few cycles. The sides where the wheels run has a channel that requires real effort to push the rack in. It's much easier now, still firm but not sticky. The top 2 racks move easily. The 2nd rack can be adjusted vertically giving more height to either the bottom or middle depending whether the rack is adjusted up or down. The silverware bin is on the bottom and is a lot smaller than we're use to. However, the top 3rd rack can hold very flat items like silverware or measuring cups. It will get used since the silverware basket is small. Also the 3rd rack can be adjusted to be a bit deeper.Installation: Took an hour to install, not counting removal of the old one. The package does not include the water line hose or the connection part. You must have them before starting. Fortunately I was able to use the connection from the old dishwasher. Had to buy the hose. The side clips used to secure the dishwasher are okay. A bit hard to install but they work. Need to install the clips right since removing them will destroy them. The old machine was hardwired. We had to redo the electric but they provide the 3 prong plug and a special outlet box with their plug wired directly.IFI: Connection to WIFI took a few tries. I had to reset twice by holding the reset button for 4 seconds. The display refreshed and then the WIFI connection worked. Not sure if I really need the app. It's useful to allowing remote start and setting a default or using the PowerControl which is must easer in the app than using the display panel, the app does let you if dishwasher is running, if the door is open or when to add drying agents and when clean the filter.Where this unit shines is how quiet it is, the cleaning which is why we have it and the options including sanitizing and drying.

Lots of combo buttons and I still need the guide to program it. Lots of options to run different cycles. We'll mostly use normal. The PowerControl is cool allowing you to decide which of 4 wash zone quadrants of the bottom tray get one of 3 cleaning levels Light-Normal-Heavy. I imagine this is really useful for cleaning a heavily soiled pan.  The dishes come out very clean and dry. One item placed on the top 3rd rack didn't clean very well but it really should have been on the bottom rack. I can't imagine anything missing on this dishwasher.Bottom rack was very difficult initially to push fully in until after running a few cycles. The sides where the wheels run has a channel that requires real effort to push the rack in. It's much easier now, still firm but not sticky. The top 2 racks move easily. The 2nd rack can be adjusted vertically giving more height to either the bottom or middle depending whether the rack is adjusted up or down. The silverware bin is on the bottom and is a lot smaller than we're use to. However, the top 3rd rack can hold very flat items like silverware or measuring cups. It will get used since the silverware basket is small. Also the 3rd rack can be adjusted to be a bit deeper.Installation: Took an hour to install, not counting removal of the old one. The package does not include the water line hose or the connection part. You must have them before starting. Fortunately I was able to use the connection from the old dishwasher. Had to buy the hose. The side clips used to secure the dishwasher are okay. A bit hard to install but they work. Need to install the clips right since removing them will destroy them. The old machine was hardwired. We had to redo the electric but they provide the 3 prong plug and a special outlet box with their plug wired directly.IFI: Connection to WIFI took a few tries. I had to reset twice by holding the reset button for 4 seconds.  The display refreshed and then the WIFI connection worked. Not sure if I really need the app. It's useful to allowing remote start and setting a default or using the PowerControl which is must easer in the app than using the display panel, the app does let you if dishwasher is running, if the door is open or when to add drying agents and when clean the filter.Where this unit shines is how quiet it is, the cleaning which is why we have it and the options including sanitizing and drying.

Její prostornost, všestranné ovládací prvky, vynikající kvalita čištění, inovativní ukazatel průběhu a neuvěřitelná tichost z ní činí špičkovou volbu pro každého, kdo potřebuje spolehlivou a tichou myčku.

Sentence (English): This Maytag dishwasher which I've had for almost a year, is great overall!
Comments (English): [ Quiet, Cleans Very Well! ] || ---------------- || This Maytag dishwasher which I've had for almost a year, is great overall! Love the 47dBA--it is so quiet you pretty much just hear minor shifting noises. This was important since its location in the kitchen is also right outside a bedroom! The top third rack really does come in very handy for low profile bowls, containers, lids and utensils. Racks are well-designed and the flatware holder removes for ease in putting them away. It cleans super, super well! Using a regular cycle is all you usually need, and it gets dried on food remnants clean with ease (I do scrape or rinse before putting in, but I don't wash every day). I once used the PowerBlast feature for dishes and one baking dish with dried on, baked on sauce that would have been a nightmare by hand---came out spotless! You can see time remaining when it's running. I do have to hand wash some mugs with designs that faded when put in the dishwasher, but I think that's normal. The racks are height adjustable which is nice. The only poor design flaw that is annoying is that when you unload you have to start at the bottom and go up because the top rack holds a lot of water in itself (not in the dishes) which splashes on the dishes below. Also, I feel like some items (maybe 1-2 a load) hold water and don't dry as well as the 15-year-old Maytag this replaced, but they spend some time in the sink drying rack which is a fine trade-off for all the pros of this item! The delivery service at the time (Best Yet Installations) was horribly rude and ignorant --argued with me about the filtration feature even though the unit has a sticker on it about it ("No dishwashers have that") and didn't leave a voice mail because "it's 2022 nobody leaves VM" but they also didn't TEXT when they were on their way and the phone call didn't go through on my phone which I showed him and he still argued with me. Luckily, I was home. They did the install though and no problems from the actual work that has come up, but they need a little training in customer interaction skills. And then gave me his card to do other plumbing work--HAHAHAHA!

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher in April 2023 based upon reviews and on sale - we did not buy the \"extra protection\" warranty.
Comments (English): [ Disappointed But Hopeful ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher in April 2023 based upon reviews and on sale - we did not buy the \"extra protection\" warranty. Installation did not occur until June 2023 due to finishing of new kitchen cabinets. Upon initial start up the unit only beeped and flashed a series of error codes. We called the store where purchased who then gave us the KitchenAid customer service contact putting us in contact with a somewhat local appliance repair company. The technician determined we either had a bad main control board or bad main motor, parts would take 5-10 business days to come in. So after approximately 6 weeks of being installed we finally have a functioning dishwasher. We made contact with KitchenAid once again to determine if the warranty could be reset to July since we had a failed unit be was told it was not possible but we could purchase an extended warranty (insurance) to cover future issues. We were frustrated in the fact a brand new dishwasher, which was \"Made in the USA\" ,failed out of the box with bad parts after supposedly passing all inspections from the factory. In addition to people selling appliances pushing extended warranties the KitchenAid customer service also pushed an extended warranty for their product. Questions remain as to why salespeople and KitchenAid itself feels the need to have such extended warranties if quality of the product might be suspicious initially. In the meantime while initially disappointed we are hopeful this dishwasher lives up to expectations.

We are using settings to sterilize for a post-transplant relative staying with us, so we are happy with the purchase.

Sentence (English): I've had this for a month and so far it is working very well; exceeding my expectation.
Comments (English): [ Great purchase. Hope this review helps you. ] || ---------------- || I've had this for a month and so far it is working very well; exceeding my expectation. I use the normal cycle which is automatically set to the pro dry setting and it gets dishes completely dry. I researched a lot of brands and all of the high end dishwashers for 7 years after my Whirlpool broke (builder grade cheapo”),but never pull the trigger in getting one because I think all of them are over priced for what you get and I couldn't find one that had overall consistently good/solid reviews. Also didn't like the configuration inside most of them, and didn't want mismatched looking appliances as a lot of them have distinct designs. I ended up going with this one (Free Flex 3rd rack 44dba) because it doesn't have a handle so would integrate well with other brands of appliances, has fingerprint resistant finish, and the features and configuration make the most sense compared to others on the market (even Bosch IMHO). The only other ones on the market that I liked the interior design of were Monogram and GE Cafe dishwashers but didn't like the stainless steel exterior as it shows streaks/prints, and didn't want the other colors Cafe comes in because I know that I won't go with their appliances when I replace my refrigerator and stove. So long story short; had to get a dishwasher now b/c I have a baby on the way and this purchase has proven to be the right choice so far. Another important thing to mention: the installers aren't great, and that isn't really a KitchenAid thing. It's just the quality of employees that work for the 3rd party install companies (ie: JB Hunt). So keep an eye on them when they install to make sure they adjust the feet correctly to make the appliance door vertically straight and aligned with the face of the cabinet (otherwise the door will not stay open correctly and the bottom drawer will roll back into the dishwasher when opened), make sure they completely hide the insulation around the appliance so that you can't see it between the cabinet and appliance, etc. We ended up taking the appliance back out to adjust the feet once the installers left to get the door vertically level (it was at an angle with the bottom protruding further than the top). We had him adjust it several times but he just couldn't quite get there.

Sentence (English): I've had this for a month and so far it is working very well; exceeding my expectation.
Comments (English): [ Great purchase. Hope this review helps you. ] || ---------------- || I've had this for a month and so far it is working very well; exceeding my expectation. I use the normal cycle which is automatically set to the pro dry setting and it gets dishes completely dry. I researched a lot of brands and all of the high end dishwashers for 7 years after my Whirlpool broke (builder grade cheapo"),but never pull the trigger in getting one because I think all of them are over priced for what you get and I couldn't find one that had overall consistently good/solid reviews. Also didn't like the configuration inside most of them, and didn't want mismatched looking appliances as a lot of them have distinct designs. I ended up going with this one (Free Flex 3rd rack 44dba) because it doesn't have a handle so would integrate well with other brands of appliances, has fingerprint resistant finish, and the features and configuration make the most sense compared to others on the market (even Bosch IMHO). The only other ones on the market that I liked the interior design of were Monogram and GE Cafe dishwashers but didn't like the stainless steel exterior as it shows streaks/prints, and didn't want the other colors Cafe comes in because I know that I won't go with their appliances when I replace my refrigerator and stove. So long story short; had to get a dishwasher now b/c I have a baby on the way and this purchase has proven to be the right choice so far. Another important thing to mention: the installers aren't great, and that isn't really a KitchenAid thing. It's just the quality of employees that work for the 3rd party install companies (ie: JB Hunt). Sentence (English): Overall a reliable quality product.
Comments (English): [ Reliable product with small weaknesses ] || ---------------- || Overall a reliable quality product. Offers a lot of storage space for dishes, more than our previous model from another manufacturer with the same external dimensions. Works quietly and the dishes get clean. The floor LED and Home Connect are very practical. Small weaknesses in the operation of the device, for example canceling time programming or an active process is unnecessarily complicated - this is easier with other brands; and we often have to press the start button twice before it registers. Compared to the essentials, these are "small" things, overall still 5 stars.
Comments (Original): [ Zuverlässiges Produkt mit kleinen Schwächen ] || ---------------- || Insgesamt ein zuverlässiges Qualitätsprodukt. Bietet sehr viel Stauraum für Geschirr, mehr als unser früheres Modell eines anderen Herstellers bei gleichen Außenmaßen. Arbeitet leise und das Geschirr wird sauber. Die Boden-LED und Home Connect sind sehr praktisch. Kleine Schwächen bei der Bedienung am Gerät, z.B. ist das Abbrechen einer Zeitprogrammierung oder eines aktiven Vorgangs unnötig kompliziert - das geht bei anderen Marken einfacher; und die Start-Taste müssen wir oft zweimal drücken, bevor sie registriert wird. Im Vergleich zum Wesentlichen sind dies aber 'kleine' Sachen, insgesamt immer noch 5 Sterne.

Sentence (English): Product Name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People.
Comments (English): Product Information. Product Name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People. Product Type: Built-in. Product Color: Kota White. Product Size: (Width) 595 x (Depth) 815 x (Height) 572 mm. * Installation Space Size: (Width) 600 x (Depth) 815 mm. Product Review. Not only does it wash thoroughly, but it also holds plenty of dishes for 14 people! --> They say bigger is better when it comes to home appliances! Especially when it comes to dishwashers, bigger is better! When cooking, you end up with dishes, pots, cups, and more. That's why the 12-person model is usually suitable for 3-5 people. The larger 14-person model can hold about 16 more dishes than the 12-person model! Thanks to this, you don't have to worry about a lot of dishes while cooking. It's so convenient. --> The dishwasher's cleaning power was excellent. It washes and washes cleanly! (However, it's much cleaner to pre-wash!) TIP) For the pre-wash, after discarding any leftover food, simply fill the bucket with water and let the used dishes sit for 5-10 minutes. It has a pretty exterior and a clean look. --> I loved it when I received it! The Kota White color blends well with any interior. The black control panel creates a clean look! Also, the Kota White panel is matte, not glossy! It feels even more luxurious. I liked it because it's a combination I don't think I'll tire of! (I heard you can change the color of the control panel! Many people use white.) The panel is replaceable, so it's a great option for refreshing your kitchen decor. It's simpler to just replace the panel than the dishwasher itself. Samsung SmartThings! Connecting makes it even easier! --> Registering your product with the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to conveniently control various cleaning functions, as well as schedule and start the dishwasher. This is a surprisingly convenient app! If you have a Samsung phone, you probably already have this app, so I recommend giving it a try! Product Review: After using the dishwasher, I think I understand why people call it "the third-generation aunt." I was worried about how well it would clean, but it's surprisingly powerful and just as good as hand-washing. Washing cups in particular used to be a real hassle, but thanks to the dishwasher, I've been using it more freely. ------------------------------------------------. Not only does it wash thoroughly, but it also holds plenty of dishes for 14 people! --> They say bigger is better when it comes to home appliances! (I heard you can change the color of the control panel! Many people use white.) The panel is replaceable, so it's a great option for refreshing your kitchen decor. It's simpler to just replace the panel than the dishwasher itself. Samsung SmartThings! Sentence (English): Product Review: After using the dishwasher, I think I understand why people call it "the third-generation aunt."
Comments (English): Product Information. Product Name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People. Product Type: Built-in. Product Color: Kota White. Product Size: (Width) 595 x (Depth) 815 x (Height) 572 mm. * Installation Space Size: (Width) 600 x (Depth) 815 mm. Product Review. Not only does it wash thoroughly, but it also holds plenty of dishes for 14 people! --> They say bigger is better when it comes to home appliances! Especially when it comes to dishwashers, bigger is better! When cooking, you end up with dishes, pots, cups, and more. That's why the 12-person model is usually suitable for 3-5 people. The larger 14-person model can hold about 16 more dishes than the 12-person model! Thanks to this, you don't have to worry about a lot of dishes while cooking. It's so convenient. --> The dishwasher's cleaning power was excellent. It washes and washes cleanly! (However, it's much cleaner to pre-wash!) TIP) For the pre-wash, after discarding any leftover food, simply fill the bucket with water and let the used dishes sit for 5-10 minutes. It has a pretty exterior and a clean look. --> I loved it when I received it! The Kota White color blends well with any interior. The black control panel creates a clean look! Also, the Kota White panel is matte, not glossy! It feels even more luxurious. I liked it because it's a combination I don't think I'll tire of! (I heard you can change the color of the control panel! Many people use white.) The panel is replaceable, so it's a great option for refreshing your kitchen decor. It's simpler to just replace the panel than the dishwasher itself. Samsung SmartThings! Connecting makes it even easier! --> Registering your product with the Samsung SmartThings app allows you to conveniently control various cleaning functions, as well as schedule and start the dishwasher. This is a surprisingly convenient app! If you have a Samsung phone, you probably already have this app, so I recommend giving it a try! I was worried about how well it would clean, but it's surprisingly powerful and just as good as hand-washing. Washing cups in particular used to be a real hassle, but thanks to the dishwasher, I've been using it more freely. ------------------------------------------------. Comments (English): [ Samsung Dishwasher Kota White ] || ---------------- || Review. Please note this is an honest review. Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher, 14-Person, DW60BB800UTES (Kota White). Washing cycles: Powerful, Standard, Automatic, Night, and Full Sterilization. Drying method: Condensation drying, Powerful drying. Sterilization method: High temperature. Washing functions: Top blade, 4-stage 3D water flow, High-temperature direct water power washing, 720-degree moving blade. Additional features: Multi-purpose shelf, wash cycle download, wine glass rack. Safety features: Leak prevention. Water consumption: 10L or more per use. Product dimensions: 59.5 x 81.5 x 57.2cm. Suitable for households of 3-5 people. Color: Kota White. Intended use: Household. Power consumption: 2,050W. Design: The design is really pretty. I wonder if it's weird that Bespoke isn't pretty. It's really clean. The Kota White color is a bit off-white, not a very white white. As the description says, "Kota" (the name "Kota" suggests a porcelain-like feel), and that's exactly the color. It feels like white baked into porcelain. The luxurious, pretty white is especially satisfying. If your kitchen design is cool-toned and white, the off-white color might look too different and unattractive. If you have lower cabinets in a different color like mine, it's a nice accent, and the off-white color doesn't stand out, so it blends in well. The touch buttons are only visible when you open the cabinet, so there's no text or anything, and it's really clean and pretty. The black and white color combination is also superb. It's really great. Pros: 1. Upper cycle. There's a cycle called "Upper Quick Wash" that only uses the upper part. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. Just adjust the amount of detergent and use the upper course, and it's perfect for a 1-2 person household. Don't worry, you only need to turn it over when guests come over, so order without worrying. A large size is much better than a small one. Don't turn it over twice or thrice! 2. Sink reform. The technician will come to reform the sink before installation. He will explain in detail and cut the mop holder to the right size. After confirming the size, he will take out all the lower cabinets and dispose of them. If you're going to use the lower cabinets as they are, you can tell him that you'll keep them. I didn't have a proper space to put them, so I asked him to dispose of them right away. Since the professional remodeled them to fit the size, the technician who comes to install them afterward will install them quickly. By the way, my lower cabinet is at the end, so if I remove it, there's nothing to support the countertop, so I incurred an additional fee of 60,000 won! 3. Undermount electric range installation. Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher, 14-Person, DW60BB800UTES (Kota White). Washing cycles: Powerful, Standard, Automatic, Night, and Full Sterilization. It feels like white baked into porcelain. The luxurious, pretty white is especially satisfying. If your kitchen design is cool-toned and white, the off-white color might look too different and unattractive. It's really great. Pros: 1. Upper cycle. There's a cycle called "Upper Quick Wash" that only uses the upper part. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. Just adjust the amount of detergent and use the upper course, and it's perfect for a 1-2 person household. Don't worry, you only need to turn it over when guests come over, so order without worrying. He will explain in detail and cut the mop holder to the right size. After confirming the size, he will take out all the lower cabinets and dispose of them. If you're going to use the same size, I really recommend adding one more to maximize your productivity. 6. Low-noise and night mode. Night mode is said to be quiet at 30 dB. It feels like white baked into porcelain. The luxurious, pretty white is especially satisfying. If your kitchen design is cool-toned and white, the off-white color might look too different and unattractive. If you have lower cabinets in a different color like mine, it's a nice accent, and the off-white color doesn't stand out, so it blends in well. It's really great. Pros: 1. Upper cycle. There's a cycle called "Upper Quick Wash" that only uses the upper part. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. He will explain in detail and cut the mop holder to the right size. After confirming the size, he will take out all the lower cabinets and dispose of them. If you're going to use the same size, I really recommend adding one more to maximize your productivity. 6. Low-noise and night mode. Night mode is said to be quiet at 30 dB. It feels like white baked into porcelain. The luxurious, pretty white is especially satisfying. If your kitchen design is cool-toned and white, the off-white color might look too different and unattractive. It's really great. Pros: 1. Upper cycle. There's a cycle called "Upper Quick Wash" that only uses the upper part. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. He will explain in detail and cut the mop holder to the right size. After confirming the size, he will take out all the lower cabinets and dispose of them. If you're going to use the lower cabinets as they are, you can tell him that you'll keep them. I didn't have a proper space to put them, so I asked him to dispose of them right away. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. Suitable for households of 3-5 people. Color: Kota White. Intended use: Household. Power consumption: 2,050W. Design: The design is really pretty. I wonder if it's weird that Bespoke isn't pretty. It's really clean. The Kota White color is a bit off-white, not a very white white. As the description says, "Kota" (the name "Kota" suggests a porcelain-like feel), and that's exactly the color. It feels like white baked into porcelain. The luxurious, pretty white is especially satisfying. If your kitchen design is cool-toned and white, the off-white color might look too different and unattractive. If you have lower cabinets in a different color like mine, it's a nice accent, and the off-white color doesn't stand out, so it blends in well. The touch buttons are only visible when you open the cabinet, so there's no text or anything, and it's really clean and pretty. The black and white color combination is also superb. It's really great. Pros: 1. Upper cycle. There's a cycle called "Upper Quick Wash" that only uses the upper part. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. Just adjust the amount of detergent and use the upper course, and it's perfect for a 1-2 person household. Don't worry, you only need to turn it over when guests come over, so order without worrying. He will explain in detail and cut the mop holder to the right size. After confirming the size, he will take out all the lower cabinets and dispose of them. If you're going to use the lower cabinets as they are, you can tell him that you'll keep them. I didn't have a proper space to put them, so I asked him to dispose of them right away. Since the professional remodeled them to fit the size, the technician who comes to install them afterward will install them quickly. By the way, my lower cabinet is at the end, so if I remove it, there's nothing to support the countertop, so I incurred an additional fee of 60,000 won! 3. Undermount electric range installation. Many places refuse to install electric ranges in series. There needs to be some leeway in height, and even if the size is available, many places refuse. Check if undermount installation is possible during the sink remodeling process. If that's not possible, you can install the electric range by raising it. This high-temperature direct water washing system eliminates the worry of plastic deformation. Once the dishwasher is done running and the automatic door opens, you'll notice a distinct heat sensation. Grease and other stains will also be washed away. Washing with hot water is best, rather than cold water. Since the dishwasher consumes electricity, not gas, you can check your electricity consumption through the Samsung SmartThings app. 5. If you're going to use the same size, I really recommend adding one more to maximize your productivity. 6. Low-noise and night mode. Night mode is said to be quiet at 30 dB. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's really great. Pros: 1. Upper cycle. There's a cycle called "Upper Quick Wash" that only uses the upper part. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. Once the dishwasher is done running and the automatic door opens, you'll notice a distinct heat sensation. Grease and other stains will also be washed away. If you're going to use the same size, I really recommend adding one more to maximize your productivity. 6. Low-noise and night mode. Night mode is said to be quiet at 30 dB. It's really great. Pros: 1. Upper cycle. There's a cycle called "Upper Quick Wash" that only uses the upper part. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. Once the dishwasher is done running and the automatic door opens, you'll notice a distinct heat sensation. Grease and other stains will also be washed away. If you're going to use the same size, I really recommend adding one more to maximize your productivity. 6. Low-noise and night mode. Night mode is said to be quiet at 30 dB. It's really great. Pros: 1. Upper cycle. There's a cycle called "Upper Quick Wash" that only uses the upper part. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. Suitable for households of 3-5 people. Color: Kota White. Intended use: Household. Power consumption: 2,050W. Design: The design is really pretty. I wonder if it's weird that Bespoke isn't pretty. It's really clean. The Kota White color is a bit off-white, not a very white white. As the description says, "Kota" (the name "Kota" suggests a porcelain-like feel), and that's exactly the color. It feels like white baked into porcelain. The luxurious, pretty white is especially satisfying. If your kitchen design is cool-toned and white, the off-white color might look too different and unattractive. If you have lower cabinets in a different color like mine, it's a nice accent, and the off-white color doesn't stand out, so it blends in well. The touch buttons are only visible when you open the cabinet, so there's no text or anything, and it's really clean and pretty. The black and white color combination is also superb. It's really great. Pros: 1. Upper cycle. There's a cycle called "Upper Quick Wash" that only uses the upper part. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. Just adjust the amount of detergent and use the upper course, and it's perfect for a 1-2 person household. Don't worry, you only need to turn it over when guests come over, so order without worrying. A large size is much better than a small one. Don't turn it over twice or thrice! 2. Sink reform. The technician will come to reform the sink before installation. He will explain in detail and cut the mop holder to the right size. After confirming the size, he will take out all the lower cabinets and dispose of them. If you're going to use the lower cabinets as they are, you can tell him that you'll keep them. I didn't have a proper space to put them, so I asked him to dispose of them right away. Since the professional remodeled them to fit the size, the technician who comes to install them afterward will install them quickly. By the way, my lower cabinet is at the end, so if I remove it, there's nothing to support the countertop, so I incurred an additional fee of 60,000 won! 3. Undermount electric range installation. Many places refuse to install electric ranges in series. There needs to be some leeway in height, and even if the size is available, many places refuse. Check if undermount installation is possible during the sink remodeling process. If that's not possible, you can install the electric range by raising it. This high-temperature direct water washing system eliminates the worry of plastic deformation. Once the dishwasher is done running and the automatic door opens, you'll notice a distinct heat sensation. Grease and other stains will also be washed away. Washing with hot water is best, rather than cold water. Since the dishwasher consumes electricity, not gas, you can check your electricity consumption through the Samsung SmartThings app. 5. Large capacity for up to 14 people. Did you know the 12-person and 14-person sizes are the same size? If you're going to use the same size built-in, adding one more is ideal. It's said to hold 16 more items than the existing 12-person model, though this may vary depending on the size of the dishes and other factors. They use the same water and electricity. If you're going to use the same size, I really recommend adding one more to maximize your productivity. 6. Low-noise and night mode. Night mode is said to be quiet at 30 dB. However, the technician said no one uses it. I was wondering why, but after using it, I understand. The washing machine itself is already incredibly quiet—about the same as a refrigerator. It feels like white baked into porcelain. The luxurious, pretty white is especially satisfying. If your kitchen design is cool-toned and white, the off-white color might look too different and unattractive. If you have lower cabinets in a different color like mine, it's a nice accent, and the off-white color doesn't stand out, so it blends in well. It's really great. Pros: 1. Upper cycle. There's a cycle called "Upper Quick Wash" that only uses the upper part. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. Just adjust the amount of detergent and use the upper course, and it's perfect for a 1-2 person household. Don't worry, you only need to turn it over when guests come over, so order without worrying. He will explain in detail and cut the mop holder to the right size. After confirming the size, he will take out all the lower cabinets and dispose of them. If you're going to use the lower cabinets as they are, you can tell him that you'll keep them. I didn't have a proper space to put them, so I asked him to dispose of them right away. It's really great. Pros: 1. Upper cycle. There's a cycle called "Upper Quick Wash" that only uses the upper part. You won't have enough dishes for 14 people every time, and if you want to do something quick and easy, just use the upper cycle to save water and time. It takes 29 minutes. I'm a two-person family, so I put 1 pot, 1 frying pan, and 2-person cutlery set in the upper part, and it's perfect. It's perfect for eating right after use, so I recommend it to anyone like me who's worried that a 14-person household might be too big. If you're going to use the same size, I really recommend adding one more to maximize your productivity. 6. Low-noise and night mode. Night mode is said to be quiet at 30 dB. Sentence (English): I have only been using my new washer a few weeks, but enjoy everything about it so far!
Comments (English): [ Love the organization & so quiet! ] || ---------------- || I have only been using my new washer a few weeks, but enjoy everything about it so far! I hope it lasts the 20+ years my old one did, also made by Whirlpool. The first one delivered from Lowe's had a large dent & opened seam in the door & had to go back, but the replacement is perfect. It was a nice install too. Some reviews mentioned trouble with the dishes not drying, but I use the regular cycle & shut off the drying cycle which saves a lot of time & energy. I set my phone timer for the time on the display then use a towel to dry off any water left collected in the top sides of cups, etc. while they're hot & in a couple minutes the residual heat has everything dry & ready for the cupboard. I don't rinse the dishes, but they always come out nice & clean even though I do wait to run it until it's full. It runs so quietly that I usually have to stop and listen for it to hear it even when sitting near by. I love how much more useful space this one has. Even my stock pot can go in! With the adjustable shelves there is a place for all my various dishes & pans. The silverware/utensil rack in the top is so handy, I've been able to take out 2 of the 3 silverware bins in the bottom & have another place for baking pans. I kept a small one in for can lids for recycling, etc. There's a bit of a learning curve to finding the best placements, but no lack of options. One reviewer suggested the plastic racks seemed “flimsy” & I had the same concern, but they are perfectly functional. Rusting racks were the only weakness in my old reliable Frigidaire. These seem like a good fix, but time will tell. My experience so far has been great & I definitely do (&have) recommend the washer. My son did the install & liked the install & my good experience with it so much he's recommended it to his landlord.

Sentence (English): We updated our kitchen and decided to upgrade to higher tier appliances.
Comments (English): [ The KitchenAid experience has been really bad ] || ---------------- || We updated our kitchen and decided to upgrade to higher tier appliances. We purchased both the KitchenAid stove and dishwasher. We hired a professional plumber to install the dishwasher because he was already installing the new sink during the remodel job. During the second use of the dishwasher, we noticed water leaking from the bottom of the door. Lowes has a small return window of 48-hours, so we were unable to return it to the location of purchase. After speaking with the KitchenAid service group, they dispatched a tech who determined the entire tub required replacement. We circled-back with the KitchenAid service group and asked for an exchange (for a working dishwasher) as opposed to having a tech rebuild a dishwasher in our kitchen (after using it twice). Note: the tech has been great to work with. It is unfortunate the faulty unit wasn't replaced weeks ago when we reported the issue. We could have had our plumber back to install it quickly, rather than waiting and rebuilding the appliance in our kitchen. We have the tech scheduled to do the rebuild next week, however we would rather have a new unit sent to us. Unfortunately, this will be my last purchase of anything from KitchenAid. I regret not reading the negative reviews on the Lowes website where three other customers reported the same - "leaking from bottom of the door" issue. Based on the trend, this may be a known issue.

Sentence (English): Last year, we relocated to a new home, one that had undergone a full kitchen remodel several years prior to our purchase.
Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher We've Had ] || ---------------- || Last year, we relocated to a new home, one that had undergone a full kitchen remodel several years prior to our purchase. The new(ish) appliances are all top-of-the-line and, for the most part, have been an easy transition for my chef wife. The dishwasher, however, has been a disappointment. Despite being a very expensive model from one of the upscale manufacturers, we've found it to be very noisy and not particularly good at the core function of cleaning dishes. In the past, we've always had Bosch diswashers and decided to replace the existing one with this Bosch 300 Series 24 inch Stainless Steel Front Control Tall Tub model. We couldn 't be more pleased with the performance! We had a similar model in our previous home, but Bosch has continued to improve the product so this new one is even better. First, it's very quiet. It's rated at 42 dbl, but in our setting it performs even better, averaging just under 35 dbl over a 3 minute period. Dishes don't need to be rinsed prior to washing - a quick scraping to remove the bulk of remaining food is all that's needed. Our dishes come out clean and dry, every time. As a tall tub model, you can fit quite a load of dishes in before it fills up. Installation was straightforward and the included instructions very clear and easy to follow. A plug in power cord is provided. A water line kit was not included with my unit, but can be purchased separately from Bosch or, as in my case, Home Depot. Overall, we're thrilled to have our Bosch dishwasher and highly recommend it!

I really liked it because it was so neat in terms of design, and the delivery was delivered the next day from purchase on the same day, so it arrived very quickly and the installer installed it and kindly installed it. When you purchase and install it, I would like it to be shipped together with detergent for one use.
